label: regular 30-minute open-to-close return; DOWN below -0.2%, DATAR within +/-0.2%, UP above +0.2%
features: known opening gap versus prior last full bar
completed prefix volume versus prior session mean
distance: mean squared standardized feature distance; inverse 1+distance weights normalized to mean one
probability: 70% Laplace-smoothed weighted class counts plus 30% same-slot Laplace baseline
selection: one fixed candidate; no outcome-based model selection or parameter tuning
baselines: same-ticker same-slot frequencies using strictly prior days
promotion: disabled; existing archives are retrospective and previously inspected; prospective evidence required
